claims.Finding: The 287-byte normal-binding body begins with a 5-byte MOV [RSP+8],RBX and has no R11 operand. The original PE runtime entry spans 3C8CD0..3C8DEF with UNWIND_INFO 6E6434; its complete-prolog stack saves must not be copied unchanged into a 5-byte trampoline. The implemented prefix plan uses SAVE_NONVOL RBX at completed offset 5/current RSP+8 and resumes at 3C8CD5. The mixed RCX/EDX/XMM2/XMM3/AL entry is preserved by the isolated compiled wrapper.
claims.Limitations: Original-byte and partial-prolog/ABI evidence, with isolated Windows unwind and synthetic continuation tests. No entry installed in KH2, whole-body native execution, resource lease, callback completeness, thread admission or Scale feature proof.
